extraction: Exact subset of the raw ACCEPT all_profiles.dat: every row with Name == 'MACS_J1149.5+2223'. Values copied verbatim (whitespace re-delimited to TAB, no numerical change). Header row = ACCEPT column names. Raw upstream file kept alongside as accept_all_profiles.dat.
note: MACS J1149.5+2223. Instrument: Chandra ACIS (archival, as of 2008 Aug). z=0.544. ACCEPT table1 average cluster temperature <kT> = 8.4 keV. Radial range 0.0-1301.0 kpc (41 bins). n_e(r) [column nelec] IS a deprojection of the Chandra surface brightness assuming spherical symmetry. T(r) [column Tx] IS a radial profile, but is the PROJECTED spectroscopic temperature interpolated onto the density bins, not a deprojected 3D temperature. NO core excision - the profile extends to the cluster centre. Mgrav in this file is hydrostatic and must not be treated as an observation.
accept_global_kT_core_excised: unknown - ACCEPT ReadMe documents <kT> only as 'Average cluster temperature' with no aperture or excision stated; treat with caution
